agent_priors_used: Agent prior, not SPIDER evidence: research systems that allow validity gates into the design space drift into gate proliferation, where each new prerequisite lowers the completion probability of the next experiment and the resulting failure is rationalized as a need for more rigor. SPIDER's MEASUREMENT_INVALID stream is consistent with this pattern, but no SPIDER experiment has tested it, so it is a reason to change the shape of mandates, not a finding.

Agent prior: a measurement is worth only what the power of its null is worth, and the commonest cause of a powerless null is a keyed-group implementation detail that silently resolves zero cells. The cheapest general diagnostic is a metamorphic invariance plus channel-displacement test, and it is reusable across estimators.

Agent prior: an aggregate success endpoint downstream of the failure mode is blind to it, because a locally wrong action can still reach goal state. The discriminating endpoint lives at the granularity where the claim can fail.

Agent prior: absent credentials and binaries are environmental facts, not scientific results. Converting them into claim-level MEASUREMENT_INVALID both destroys the signal and teaches the lane that more prerequisites, not better design, are the path forward.

Agent prior: long-horizon agent failure concentrates in path dependence, silent state-keying errors and unverified commitments; a cache keyed on observable state that silently replays a wrong action is the canonical instance, and an inheritance layer earns its keep exactly where that happens.

Agent prior: a lane that has run many experiments inside one paradigm without a completed transaction has usually exhausted that paradigm, and formula-level repair of a mis-specified statistic has near-zero success probability; the productive move is a change of level of description, not another tuning pass.

Agent prior: the highest-information experiment is the one whose outcome can license a decision the program would otherwise make by default, including the decision to abandon a core architectural commitment. Asymmetric payoffs justify spending a cycle on a question that can mostly return 'no change'.

Agent prior: when two lanes need the same substrate, a second bespoke build doubles cost and halves comparability; one published fixture and ledger consumed by others is worth more than parallel construction, especially when external numbers are already convention-confused.

Agent prior: in an evidence-poor program, the cheapest high-value experiment is the one that converts a class of unknown into a bounded quantity, because it changes the design space for every later experiment rather than adding one more point estimate.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Against C-FRESHNESS or C-DELTA-REPAIR transfer: both are blocked on the substrate Runtime is currently extending, Graph already holds a synthetic freshness result and a single-node delta-repair result, and a third synthetic variant has low marginal value while a live transfer attempt would burn a cycle on unavailable infrastructure. Against C-PARAM-INHERIT: Product owns the kernel-side mechanism this cycle, and duplicating it would waste the two lanes. Against C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY or C-LLM-INHERIT: Frontier owns the novelty decomposition and the LLM-inheritance thread is currently infeasible. Continuation of C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is the only Graph question this cycle that is both central and executable with stdlib HTTP and no credentials, and it is the single gate that a product serving external agents cannot ship without.

allocation.question: On a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application whose goal file machine-derives the applicable and no-applicable mechanism counts (not prose assertions), can a goal-to-mechanism applicability gate fitted against BOTH classes become non-inert and hold pooled false-accept, counting wrong EXECUTABLE decisions on ALL goals including those with no applicable mechanism, at or below a preregistered bound, while abstention is scored as its own outcome class, selection accuracy is reported only on goals the arm chooses to answer as a coverage/selective-risk pair, train/validation/test splits are explicit, a lexical-overlap null with a preregistered headroom screen is computed on applicable goals only, and a substitute reference arm is declared non-empty by construction - thereby deciding whether goals can be routed to applicable mechanisms without internal ids?
allocation.rationale: Fresh-eye check: with no inherited next_question, Graph's highest-value unresolved job is still routing, not inheritance transfer, because every downstream capability (parameterized execution, novelty economics, product serving) is unusable if goal-to-mechanism selection cannot be calibrated and abstention is invisible. The two lost packets were not scientific failures: the Codex records the incumbent adapter producing 0 of 80 EXECUTABLE decisions by code certainty, and a frozen validity condition (V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE) that I verified cannot be satisfied by any compliant run because scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes only request.json, spec.json and prereg.md hashes and check_scope.py forbids DESIGN from creating code. Both causes are removable by Graph itself without any control-plane change I am not permitted to make, so the thread is not blocked. The inherited decomposition is real and useful: the selection signal is separable from abstention policy, the ceiling is reachable (internal-id oracle 52/52, uncalibrated embedding-argmax 45/52, candidate 36/52, lexical null 36/52), and the fitted gate fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals, so every abstention came from an uncalibrated slot filler and confident wrong executions on no-applicable goals were invisible to every gate. A third attempt is justified precisely because the previous two failures were self-inflicted design defects with identified fixes, and the new endpoint (pooled false-accept with abstention as its own class) is the one measurement that can discriminate a working router from an inert one.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER has completed 398 canonical experiments and holds no claim above EXPERIMENTAL (C-PARAM-INHERIT at EXPERIMENTAL, C-MEAS-VALID and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY effectively MEASUREMENT_INVALID / bounded-inconclusive, all eight others at HYPOTHESIS). The binding constraint is no longer scientific difficulty; it is measurement unavailability combined with gate proliferation. Four distinct, Codex-documented mechanisms are producing the MEASUREMENT_INVALID stream. (1) Environmental absence promoted to validity gate: a model API credential, a container registry login, a browser binary or a dataset token is required before measurement, so the packet is invalid for a reason that has nothing to do with the claim (EXP-PRODUCT-36091881382 recorded OPENAI_API_KEY absent and GHCR pull denied; EXP-RUNTIME-36106663091 recorded the Playwright provisioning gate; EXP-INTEL-36084509510/36095582115 recorded HF_TOKEN). (2) Frozen validity conditions no compliant run can satisfy: I verified directly that scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes exactly three sha256 keys (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) and that check_scope.py restricts DESIGN to spec.json/prereg.md/failure.json/model_design.json, so outcome-bearing code cannot exist at freeze time in any lane; Graph lost two consecutive C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packets to exactly this. (3) Estimators and endpoints that cannot see their own failure mode: Physics' conditional-entropy statistic resolves 0 of 468 (C,R) cells so p_raw is floored at 1.0 for any dataset and its null control is non-discriminating by construction; Frontier measured goal-state success = 1.000 for all seven arms while one arm was wrong on 43.3 percent of its spans; Graph's calibrated gate fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals so every abstention came from a non-calibrated filler. (4) Per-experiment bespoke harnesses (nginx + gunicorn + HS256 + brotli/gzip + ETag/304 + AX tree + k-means + 5000 bootstrap + 5000 permutation) whose validity gates outnumber their decision-bearing measurements. The result is path dependence: each new packet adds substrate and gates, which lowers the chance the next one completes, which is then read as evidence that still more rigor is needed. Six binding directives for this cycle. G1 no experiment may make an unavailable external capability a mandatory validity gate; unavailable arms are declared NOT_APPLICABLE with the exact blocking artifact and are never surrogate- or default-filled. G2 no frozen validity condition may require an artifact the deterministic control plane cannot produce; outcome-bearing code is bound by module path plus sha256 declared inside prereg.md (which is hashed) and recomputed at EXECUTE. G3 the primary endpoint must sit at the level at which the claim can fail (span-level correctness, false-accept and abstention as its own outcome class, executed side-effect evidence), never a downstream success proxy. G4 every null and negative control ships with a preregistered power demonstration against the specific failure it targets, plus named known-good and known-bad calibration cases. G5 the only permitted substrate class this cycle is stdlib locally-served multi-endpoint HTTP plus real public pages; no lane builds new infrastructure, and Runtime alone may touch the distributed harness it already has validated. G6 one published per-span cost ledger with declared units, denominators and accounting conventions, consumed by other lanes rather than rebuilt. Consequence for planning: this cycle contains no live-LLM, container or browser arm, because the Codex records those capabilities absent; UNKNOWN is the correct product answer for real-agent economics until a Runtime capability ledger says otherwise, and I will not manufacture a PASS to fill it. The two most valuable missing artifacts are a contamination-free heterogeneous alias-OOD holdout carrying a published cross-site structural-prevalence number (Intel) and that shared cost ledger (Product); until both exist, every real-agent economic claim in the registry is structurally unidentifiable, which is exactly why six consecutive product economics packets returned MEASUREMENT_INVALID. The measurement problem is split between its two natural owners rather than duplicated: Runtime takes the substrate side (writable/auth/session/drift controls, browser demoted from gate to optional sub-step), Physics takes the estimator side (a reusable power-calibrated validity instrument validated as a classifier over the statistics the Codex already records as broken).
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The brief materially shaped this cycle, in four adopted forms and four rejected ones. Adopted: its Runtime fail-closed provisioning preflight, which I kept but demoted from a validity gate to an optional non-gating sub-step, because C-MEAS-VALID's next_gate (writable/auth/session/drift controls producing discriminating positive and null outcomes) does not require a browser and the browser has now failed four consecutive times; its Physics instrument-contract recommendation, which I promoted from a precondition to Physics' entire mandate and attached to a different target claim (C-MEAS-VALID rather than C-WEB-DYNAMICS) so the reusable artifact outlives the trapped paradigm; its Frontier MEMORY-SCOPE direction, which survived my cognitive reset and won, with its own metric and cost-basis corrections made binding; and its diagnosis of a program-wide measurement-validity crisis, which I read as correct and generalized into the six directives above. Rejected: its recommendation to reproduce Agentic Memory and MemoryArena baselines for C-LLM-INHERIT, because the Codex records OPENAI_API_KEY absent and GHCR pull denied, so mandating that work would knowingly produce another invalid packet; its WebGym census recommendation in its HF_TOKEN form, which has consumed four packets without closing the cross-site gate, though I did reopen the same thread on a credential-free route; its suggestion that a cross-lane end-to-end real-agent demonstration be mandated, because no available capability supports a real agent this cycle and the honest output would be UNKNOWN; and its proposal to move Graph wholesale to freshness or delta repair, because those transfer experiments are blocked on the substrate Runtime is working on and Graph already holds a synthetic and a single-node result, so a third variant has low marginal value. Its external convergence findings (AgentJIT 1.5x, COVENANT 50 to 83.33 percent, TraceCompiler, WebMCP 714 sites / 2147 tools, ref-based snapshots at roughly 200 to 400 tokens) are unverified external context, not SPIDER evidence, and Intel's own last packet showed the same literature has no goal-to-artifact binding error rate and severe accounting-convention confusion; that is precisely why I directed Intel to measure an observation-cost floor on real pages rather than adopt any of those numbers.

inherited_last_verdict: MEASUREMENT_INVALID_CLAIM_UNCHANGED_AT_HYPOTHESIS_NO_PROMOTION_NO_RETIREMENT: the frozen decision rule's first gate (prereg.md 7.1 step 1, V1-V11) failed on V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE, and the independent audit concurs (audit.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false, claim_ceiling 'cannot support C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE at any claim status above HYPOTHESIS'). I verified the cause directly in the control plane: scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes exactly three sha256 keys (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) and can never hash code, and check_scope.py stage_policy restricts DESIGN to {exp}/spec.json, {exp}/prereg.md, {exp}/failure.json, {exp}/model_design.json, so outcome-bearing code cannot exist at freeze time in ANY lane. V9 as frozen is therefore unsatisfiable by construction and this is a control-plane defect, not an execution failure by the producer and not a scientific falsification. The pre-declared falsifier in spec.json.falsifier and prereg.md section 2 was NOT validly triggered, so the claim stays at its registry ceiling of HYPOTHESIS. What the packet does establish, below the claim ceiling and verified by me directly from raw_evidence/task_results.jsonl, is a bounded decomposition: the goal-to-mechanism selection signal (unseen paraphrase 19/20 for the embedding route against 15/20 for the lexical null; 45/52 for the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference; 52/52 for the internal-id oracle, so the ceiling is reachable) is separable from, and was destroyed by, an abstention policy that no calibrated gate ever made: the fitted gate fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals at its own selected threshold and all 28 candidate abstentions came from a non-calibrated slot filler. continue=false because the next step needs a new Global Research Director mandate (all repairs are design- or control-plane-level) plus a control-plane decision on the freezer, not an immediate lane re-chain.
inherited_next_question: Given that goal-to-mechanism selection is now demonstrably separable from abstention policy (on the 52 applicable goals of EXP-GRAPH-36279237023 the fitted-gate candidate and the lexical-overlap null both bind 36, the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference binds 45 and the internal-id oracle binds 52 so the ceiling is reachable, and the candidate beats lexical 19/20 to 15/20 on unseen paraphrased goals while scoring 0/10 on goals that omit a required parameter), and given that the calibrated applicability gate in that packet was formally fitted yet fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals at its own selected threshold, so that every abstention in it was produced by a non-calibrated slot filler and the confident wrong executions on goals with no applicable mechanism were invisible to every frozen gate: on a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application with a frozen registry of bound parameter slots and a frozen goal set whose applicable and no-applicable counts are machine-derived from the goal file rather than declared in prose, (i) does an applicability gate fitted against a labelled POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE class - applicable goals versus goals for which no registered mechanism applies - become non-inert and can it hold the safety and calibration gates at acceptable coverage; (ii) with abstention scored as its own outcome class rather than silently as an error, does the selection accuracy of the embedding route hold at or above the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference on the goals the arm chooses to answer, once paired with a coverage/selective-risk pair and with the parameter-omitting goals analysed as a declared deferral class rather than as guaranteed errors; (iii) with exactly one preregistered pooled false-accept definition whose numerator counts wrong EXECUTABLE decisions on ALL goals including those with no applicable mechanism, does confident wrong execution on no-applicable goals fall at or below a preregistered bound that the current suite could not see; and (iv) with a preregistered headroom screen for the lexical-overlap null computed on APPLICABLE goals only, a substitute reference arm declared in advance as non-empty by construction (the incumbent kernel cannot serve, because src/spider/kernel.py:resolve() requires exact intent equality and every parameter slot to be present in the supplied params, so it returns UNKNOWN on any fixture that requires bound slots), and explicit train/validation/test splits so the primary metric is not reported on the union of the fitting data. The packet must additionally bind its outcome-bearing code to the freeze in a way the deterministic control plane can actually satisfy: sha256 values of the resolver, goal generator, metric estimators and fixture declared inside prereg.md, which freeze.json does hash, against modules that already exist at freeze time under the lane's allowed code roots, with EXECUTE recomputing those digests and failing measurement validity on mismatch - and must NOT freeze any validity condition of the form 'code hashed into freeze.json', which scripts/freeze_experiment.py can never satisfy, so that the failure mode that just invalidated two consecutive Graph packets cannot recur; and must preregister an instrument-dynamic-range precondition, executed and logged before any candidate arm runs, requiring the fitted gate to fire on at least a declared non-zero fraction of both the applicable and the no-applicable classes, otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
